description: This file implements a singleton class 'ConversationContextProvider' for managing OpenTelemetry tracing context and conversation IDs within the Pipecat project. It provides methods to set, get, and generate conversation-specific tracing contexts and IDs, facilitating distributed tracing in conversations.

classes.name: ConversationContextProvider
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the current conversation's tracing context and ID, providing methods to set and retrieve these contexts for distributed tracing.

methods.name: get_instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ConversationContextProvider.

methods.name: set_current_conversation_context
methods.description: Sets the current conversation's tracing context and optional conversation ID.

methods.name: get_current_conversation_context
methods.description: Retrieves the current conversation's OpenTelemetry context.

methods.name: generate_conversation_id
methods.description: Generates a new UUID string to be used as a conversation ID.
